summary: Albany County, WY two-story lookout: 1938 federal lookout reserve, 1940s-50s staffing, cab removed 1977 for the WIRO observatory now on the summit.

facts.design: 10-foot stone base topped with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Cab removed in 1977; the summit now holds the University of Wyoming's Wyoming Infrared Observatory.

access.note: Working university observatory; public daytime tours are by reservation through the UW Physics & Astronomy Department.

corrections.why: The listing describes a 10-foot stone base topped with an L-4 cab, and the 9656 ft figure is elevation. No source supports 202.7 m.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Rex's Fire Lookout Page and Forest Lookouts pages name the Bureau of Land Management, but the 1938 order reserved the tract for Forest Service use, and the 1946 and 1953 items place the lookout in the Medicine Bow National Forest. The story notes both.
The 1953 article gives the summit as 9,665 feet. The Rex's listing gives elevation 9656 feet and the university gives 9,656 feet. The story gives both figures and attributes each.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 202.7 has no source support; see corrections. Agency in the brief (BLM) is what the listings say, but the 1938 order reserved the land for the Forest Service; the story reports both. The Facebook post (FFLA, 1941 photo, 'likely built in the mid-1930's') appeared only in a search snippet and is not used. The 1953 9,665 ft figure conflicts with 9,656 ft; both are reported. No new photos recorded. Search budget: one websearch.py fallback query; four page reads.
